channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: North Palm Beach Celebrates Fourth of July with Fireworks and America 250 Events
item.description: North Palm Beach residents and visitors will celebrate Independence Day with a full day of family-friendly activities, live entertainment and fireworks at North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse on July 4.

item.title: Juno Beach considers thousands in costs to replace fence at JB-7 beach access after resident complaints
item.description: Colony Condos residents say beachgoers have been cutting through their private property since the town removed a fence at the JB-7 public walkway in 2023, leading to confrontations and police calls.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach was selected as one of just 10 communities nationwide to receive the prestigious National Civic League honor, recognizing efforts to strengthen community engagement and civic participation.

item.title: Palm Beach County schools earn third consecutive A rating from state with record graduation rate
item.description: The School District of Palm Beach County received an A rating from the state for the third year in a row, with 84 percent of district-operated schools rated A or B and a record 93.5 percent graduation rate.

item.title: Boca Raton Community High School band to represent Florida at National Independence Day Parade
item.description: The Boca Raton Community High School band will march a full mile along the National Mall in Washington D.C. on July 4, representing the entire state of Florida at the prestigious parade.

item.title: Breast cancer patient denied coverage for reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, had her insurance claim denied by Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield less than 24 hours before scheduled breast reconstruction surgery using GalaFlex mesh.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4 percent this year
item.description: A holiday meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4 percent from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman dies in home fire as investigators point to electrical cause
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside her Hobe Sound home. Friends have launched a fundraiser to help her fiance Mark rebuild after the flames destroyed their belongings.

item.title: Martin County School Board fights judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk comments
item.description: The Martin County School Board is pushing back against a judge's recommendation to reinstate a teacher suspended last year following controversial social media .

item.title: Stuart's downtown dock closes Sunday for $3 million renovation that doubles slip capacity
item.description: The dock will close July 6 for renovations projected to be complete by next Fourth of July. When finished, the project will nearly double the dock's capacity, expanding from 18 to 44 slips for both motorized and non-motorized vessels.

item.title: Juno Beach condo residents demand town replace fence at JB-7 beach access point
item.description: Residents at the Colony Condos say people using the JB-7 public walkway are cutting through their private property since the town removed the old fence in 2023 for safety reasons. A fix could cost the town thousands of dollars.

item.title: Port St. Lucie approves land transfer for new Florida Turnpike interchange at Midway Road
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to FDOT to assist with a partial interchange. The city is also working on a $95 million road widening project along Midway Road.

item.title: West Palm Beach evaluates elevated autonomous transit system linking airport to downtown
item.description: Glydways, a California-based autonomous transit company, is proposing an elevated network of self-driving vehicles connecting downtown West Palm Beach to President Donald J. Trump International Airport. The system could cut the trip to less than 10 minutes.

item.title: Martin County maritime teams deploy two boats with medics for Fourth of July weekend
item.description: Lt. Brett Harry with Martin County Maritime Response Unit said they're expecting hundreds of boaters to be on the water celebrating this weekend. His team will have two boats with medics on standby in Martin County in the north and south.

item.title: Lantana veteran gets lien removed and roof fixed after WPTV investigation
item.description: Stephen McCoy, a disabled and retired veteran in Lantana, had a nearly $7,000 lien lifted from his home and unfinished roof repairs completed after WPTV contacted the roofing contractor.

item.description: St. Petersburg Mayor Ken Welch selected The Burg Bid as the city's preferred proposal for redeveloping Tropicana Field and the Historic Gas Plant District, centered on a 13-acre civic park and permanent home for The Woodson African American Museum of Florida.
